'''Treads''', also known as '''Motorized Treads''', were a locomotion system used by [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. R-series [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had two standard treads on the bottom of their main legs, with a third tread that could be retracted into the unit's body.<ref name="EGTD" /> The treads allowed the astromechs to travel over a vareity of terrain, and they were driven by an [[Everett/Legends|Everett]] [[Mark IV Locomotion System/Legends|Mark IV Locomotion System]].<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref>
